title: Matrix factorization analyses of the immgenT scRNA-seq data

This site documents the gene program (GP) factorization analysis of the ImmGen-T
single-cell RNA-seq/CITE-seq data: ~200 GPs learned by empirical Bayes matrix
factorization (EBMF), and how they relate to cell lineage, tissue, activation
state, transcription factors, and surface protein expression.

Each page below covers one published figure: for every panel, the R code that
produced it, the figure itself, and the published caption.

## Main figures

+ [Figure 1: A gene-program architecture underlies T cell heterogeneity across the immgenT atlas](Figure1.html)
+ [Figure 2: Individual T cells deploy sparse combinations of gene programs that expand with activation](Figure2.html)
+ [Figure 3: T cell lineage identity is encoded by both lineage-restricted and shared gene programs](Figure3.html)
+ [Figure 4: Activated T cell states arise from shared and lineage-biased combinations of gene programs](Figure4.html)
+ [Figure 5: Tissue-associated gene programs reflect both tissue adaptation and T cell subset composition](Figure5.html)
+ [Figure 6: Surface-marker associations are context-dependent, but combinatorial gating resolves specific gene programs](Figure6.html)
+ [Figure 7b: A nonlinear deep-learning framework independently recovers the immgenT gene-program landscape](Figure7.html)

Figure 7 (A nonlinear deep-learning framework independently recovers the
immgenT gene-program landscape) brings the EBMF programs documented here
together with RQVI, a non-linear deep-learning factorization of the same cells.
Panel **b**, the cluster-level comparison of the two factorizations, is
documented on the page above; the RQVI panels are documented in the
[companion repository for the RQVI framework](https://github.com/TianzeCompbio/RQVI_GP_figures/tree/main).

## Reproducing these figures

Every page above is generated by a single R script in
[`script/`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/tree/main/script),
which sources shared plotting/data-loading helpers from
[`code/R/`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/immgenT-GP-analysis/tree/main/code/R).
To regenerate a figure yourself, run (from the repository root):

```
Rscript script/Figure1.R
```
